lastCompletedStory.title: Build the pure PRD-oracle linter module (named-rules scanner + PRD walk)

nextStoryContext: prd-oracle-lint.ts exports RULES (named-rules list: { name, test(command): RuleFinding | null }) and lintPrd(prd: PrdShape): PrdOracleLintFinding[]. lintPrd is currently unwired -- nothing calls it yet (no CLI entrypoint, no plan-phase integration). A likely next story wires lintPrd into the plan phase (e.g. after the planner writes prd.json, or as a scripts/check-*.ts gate) and surfaces findings to the operator/auditor. Adding a second rule to RULES is a one-liner (push another OracleLintRule). The rule intentionally only recognizes short-option grep flags (-q/-L/-l, bundled or separate); long-form flags (--quiet, --files-without-match) are out of scope per the AC wording and were not implemented.
